description: This file defines the EntityTag class, which models HTTP entity tags according to RFC 7232, including validation, comparison, and creation methods.

classes.name: EntityTag
classes.description: Immutable class representing an HTTP entity tag, supporting validation, equality, and comparison methods according to RFC 7232.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether a given character sequence matches the entity tag format, considering optional weak prefix and quoted string.

methods.name: getOpaqueTag
methods.description: Returns the opaque part of the entity tag.

methods.name: isWeak
methods.description: Indicates whether the entity tag is weak.

methods.name: strongCompareTo
methods.description: Performs a strong comparison between this and another entity tag based on RFC 7232.

methods.name: weakCompareTo
methods.description: Performs a weak comparison between this and another entity tag.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an EntityTag instance from its string representation, parsing weak prefix if present.

methods.name: fromEntity
methods.description: Builds an EntityTag from an object entity, if possible.

methods.name: strong
methods.description: Constructs a strong EntityTag with the specified opaque tag.

methods.name: weak
methods.description: Constructs a weak EntityTag with the specified opaque tag.
